Namibian Cheetah Gaurav Dies at Kuno National Park

Gaurav, one of the original Namibian cheetahs brought to Madhya Pradesh's Kuno National Park, has died. He was among the eight cheetahs translocated from Namibia in September 2022. Gaurav, originally named Elton, was referred to as a 'Rock Star' and was the last surviving Namibian male cheetah at the park. Another cheetah, Shaurya (formerly Freddy), who arrived with Gaurav, had died two years prior.
